why: Tier-1 CI tooling: scripts/ci/check_register_ids.py, one new test file, one row appended to docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no workflows. NOT in LANDING_MACHINERY, so R12 does not apply. WHAT IT FIXES, OBSERVED RATHER THAN CONSTRUCTED: while main carried a duplicate register id (fixed by PR #12381) ONE run of this guard printed both 'health-review-backlog.json::items[id]: 1600 rows, unique' in the census AND '::error::A register id collided ... appears at rows 1596 AND 1598'. The code did `problems += check_uniqueness(...)` and then printed the LITERAL word 'unique' on five report lines whatever that call returned -- UNPROVENANCED DIAGNOSTIC OUTPUT sub-class A. The census is the part a reader skims, so the two disagreeing is worse than either alone. [!] THE FILE HAD ALREADY FIXED THE SIBLING HALF: _rows's docstring records an absent array once reporting '0 rows, unique' and calls it the collapsed-state defect this repo keeps a guard for; that repair made the ROW COUNT honest and left the word a literal. The fix reached the instance, not the class -- the third instance of that shape today after #12378 and #12379. [!] THE EMPTY-ARRAY CASE IS DELIBERATELY UNTOUCHED and still reads '0 rows, unique': a present, empty array is trivially unique and the module's own self-test asserts that exact string. What was wrong is asserting uniqueness for a file with a COLLISION. CONTROLS: 6 tests, four planted defects, all four caught. The PARTIAL-FIX plant is the load-bearing one (the literal appeared at five sites and the --base variants are what a real CI run reaches, so repairing four would look fixed and still lie on the live path), and the fourth plant is the positive control (deleting the word everywhere passes a collision-only suite while destroying the guard's ability to report a clean register). [!] MY OWN STRUCTURAL TEST OVER-REPORTED FIRST and it is recorded rather than quietly fixed: matching the substring 'rows, unique' flagged three NON-census lines -- the docstring quoting the historical output, the self-test, and the comment I had just written explaining the defect. Explaining the bug created a finding about it. It now keys on the TEMPLATE '{len(head_rows)} rows, unique', with a vacuity control proving the scan can still go red. CLASS SWEEP, MEASURED: a structural search of scripts/ci for the shape this needs (a per-item census loop that also accumulates problems) finds EXACTLY ONE function -- this one. A looser scan flags 27 report lines hardcoding a verdict word, but those are terminal prints on the success path, which is correct. The sweep is AST-shape matching and could miss a variant; stated rather than implying completeness.
